title: SEO Specialist / Analyst
description: JOB DETAILS AT A GLANCE Hours: Full-time, 40 hours/week Timezone Overlap: Minimum 6 hours overlap Mon–Fri, 8:00 AM–2:00 PM US Mountain Time (MT/MST/MDT). Your remaining 2 hours can be worked anytime before or after that window. Contract Type: Month-to-month contract to start, with the potential to move into a permanent position as the role and team grow Pay Rate: $4.61–$7.51/hr USD (based on experience) Time Tracking: Teamwork Payroll: Gusto English Level: C2 — Advanced/Mastery required Location: Remote ABOUT BANDICOOT MARKETING Bandicoot Marketing is a WordPress-focused digital marketing agency serving small-local to large-national businesses in Georgia and across the United States. We are WordPress-first, results-driven, and honest with our clients. We don’t chase every trend — but we do stay ahead of the ones that matter. Our SEO department is growing, and we’re building it the right way — with people who understand the craft, not just the tools. This role is an opportunity to grow alongside a team that takes SEO seriously and work on strategies that are ahead of where most small agencies are operating. WHERE WE ARE RIGHT NOW — PLEASE READ THIS We want to be straightforward with you about what this role looks like right now versus where it’s headed. Right now, we have a backlog of content that needs to be written, optimized, and added to client sites. The immediate, day-to-day reality of this role will be: •  Writing SEO + GEO optimized content using Surfer SEO and Claude •  Adding that content to WordPress sites with full on-page SEO (URL, title, meta, H tags, schema, images, internal links) •  Manual citation and directory listing work •  Backlink outreach — finding prospects, sending personalized email s, tracking placements This is real, meaningful SEO work. But we want you to know upfront that the bulk of your hours to start will be content production and citation/outreach work, not high-level strategy. Over time, as we catch up and the department grows, this role is designed to expand into everything listed in the full job description below — including technical SEO, competitor research, data analysis, reporting, and strategy collaboration with our SEO Director. IMMEDIATE RESPONSIBILITIES (MONTHS 1–3) Content Creation & Publishing - Write SEO and GEO-optimized content using Surfer SEO for optimization guidance and Claude for drafting and E-E-A-T refinement - Structure every piece of content for LLM/AI visibility — clear H tags, well-chunked sections, direct answers, and entity-rich language - Publish content directly to WordPress (Elementor) — you own the full workflow from draft to live page - Optimize every page at time of publication: URL slug, page title, SEO title, meta description, H1–H4 structure, image alt text and file naming, schema markup, and internal links to relevant pillar and cluster pages - Build internal silo structure — link new content to and from existing pages to pass authority and signal topical relevance Citation & Directory Work - Run manual citation building campaigns — building and cleaning directory listings across core and hyper-local directories - Audit and correct NAP consistency across all platforms - Manage citation campaigns Backlink Outreach - Research backlink prospects — relevant blogs, local press, directories, and competitor link sources - Write and send personalized outreach email s for guest posts, resource mentions, and link placements - Track all outreach activity and log placements - Follow up on outstanding outreach and monitor acquired links for removal FULL ROLE SCOPE (WHERE THIS POSITION IS HEADED) As the role evolves, you’ll take on increasing responsibility across all of the following areas. We’re sharing the full picture now so you can see where this leads and whether it’s the kind of work you want to grow into. Technical SEO & On-Page - Conduct technical SEO audits and implement fixes across WordPress (Elementor) client sites - Optimize on-page elements across all existing and new content — URL structure, page title, SEO title, meta description, H tag hierarchy, image alt text and file naming, and internal link architecture - Schema markup implementation and validation - Site speed and Core Web Vitals monitoring and optimization Local SEO - Optimize and manage local SEO presence across Google Business Profile, Bing Places, and Apple Business Connect - Support entity and brand building — structured data, knowledge panels, brand mentions, and consistent NAP across the web Content Strategy - Help develop long-term content cluster strategies — mapping pillar pages, supporting spokes, and topical coverage gaps - Help plan and prioritize content roadmaps that build topical authority over time, not just individual rankings - Conduct ongoing competitor research — analyze competitor content strategies, topic coverage, keyword rankings, and SERP positioning - Apply Google’s E-E-A-T principles throughout content planning and production GEO / LLM Optimization - Implement and monitor GEO / LLM optimization strategies to improve visibility in AI-generated answers across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Grok - Structure content deliberately for AI crawling and citation — clear headings, chunked answers, entity signals, and direct-answer formatting Data Analysis & Reporting - Monitor and analyze performance across Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, Screaming Frog, GT Metrix, and Ahrefs - Run regular competitor SEO audits — track ranking movements, new content, backlink acquisition, and authority growth - Help diagnose traffic anomalies and ranking shifts with clear, evidence-backed explanations - Help pull together clear, consistent monthly client reports that connect SEO activity to real business outcomes - Monthly strategy collaboration with the SEO Director TOOLS YOU’LL WORK WITH Day-to-day proficiency with most of these tools is expected. We will train the right candidate on any gaps. - Search: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools - SEO Research: Ahrefs - Technical: Screaming Frog, GT Metrix - Local SEO: Google Business Profile, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect - Content & CMS: WordPress + Elementor, Surfer SEO - Project & Payroll: Teamwork (time tracking), Gusto (payroll) - AI & Productivity: Claude Cowork, Search Atlas QUALIFICATIONS Required - C2 English proficiency (Advanced/Mastery) — strong written English is essential for content creation and client-facing reports - 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, ideally in an agency environment managing multiple client accounts - Proven ability to implement on-page and technical SEO — not just recommend it - Experience publishing content directly in WordPress including all on-page SEO tasks at time of publication - Strong writer who can produce clear, accurate, well-structured SEO content using AI tools like Claude efficiently without sacrificing quality - Comfortable with manual outreach work — prospecting, personalized email s, follow-up, and tracking - Comfortable with citation and directory work — detailed, methodical, and accurate - Strong analytical skills — you can find the signal in the data and explain what it means - Comfortable working independently with real accountability for client outcomes - Genuine curiosity about how search and AI-generated answers are evolving High-Value Skills (Not required, but candidates with experience in any of the following will stand out significantly) - Backlink building & outreach — campaign strategy, prospecting, and relationship-based link acquisition - Entity & brand building — structured data, knowledge panels, brand mention tracking, and consistent brand signals - GEO / LLM optimization — improving visibility in AI-generated answers (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Grok) - GEO-aware content structuring — deliberate chunking, entity signals, and direct-answer patterns that AI crawlers surface - Content cluster architecture — designing hub-and-spoke topical authority structures that compound in value over time Nice to Have - Familiarity with WordPress (Elementor) from an SEO perspective — not asking you to build sites, but understanding how they work helps - Experience with city/service landing page strategies and local search network builds - Basic HTML/CSS comfort for implementing technical fixes without always needing a developer GROWTH & REPORTING STRUCTURE This role reports to our SEO Director, who owns overall strategy, client communication, and results accountability. You will not be working in isolation — we collaborate closely and meet monthly to review results and align on priorities. We are a growing SEO department inside an established digital marketing agency. The right person for this role will grow with us. We’re upfront that today the work is hands-on and execution-heavy. But we’re investing in building something solid, and we want a tea ---------- mber who wants to be part of that. The month-to-month contract structure is how we start all new relationships — it protects both sides and gives us a chance to build trust before making a longer commitment. HOW TO APPLY Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. In your application, please include: - A short introduction telling us who you are and why this role is a good fit for where you are in your career - 2–3 examples of SEO work you’ve done — content you’ve written and published, technical fixes you’ve implemented, outreach campaigns you’ve run, or results you’ve driven - Any experience with the tools listed above - Your availability and current timezone

title: Paid Media & Marketing Operations Manager
description: # Paid Media & Marketing Operations Manager ## About Us We’re an AI-first marketing agency based in Australia, focused on performance, systems, innovation, and building things properly. We work across paid media, primarily Google Ads and Meta Ads, alongside SEO, automation, AI tools, reporting systems, Shopify, lead generation, and custom internal apps. We move fast, solve problems quickly, and constantly improve the systems inside the business. We are not looking for someone who simply follows SOPs. We are looking for someone who can think independently, identify problems, improve systems, take ownership, and help us scale. This is not a junior role. This is a long-term role for somebody who wants to grow with the company and become a core part of the team. --- ## The Role We are hiring a full-time Paid Media & Marketing Operations Manager. Your role will involve managing campaigns, improving systems, building reporting processes, working with AI tools, solving operational problems, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. You will work directly with the founder and become heavily involved in the operational side of the agency. This is a dynamic role, not a repetitive VA role. Some weeks you may be: * launching Meta campaigns * optimising Google Ads campaigns * improving reporting systems * troubleshooting tracking issues * improving attribution accuracy * helping build AI workflows * auditing landing pages * improving internal systems * managing Shopify marketing tasks * identifying inefficiencies before anybody else notices them We value initiative very highly. You should already be comfortable independently launching and managing campaigns. If you wait to be told every small step, this role is not for you. --- ## What You’ll Be Responsible For * Setting up and managing Google Ads campaigns * Setting up and managing Meta Ads campaigns * Monitoring performance and improving campaign results * Creating and improving reporting systems * Building dashboards and client reporting workflows * Setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking * Managing Google Tag Manager, GA4, Meta Pixel, and Events Manager setups * Diagnosing tracking issues and ensuring accurate attribution * Working with AI tools to improve efficiency * Assisting with SEO-related tasks and strategy * Helping improve agency systems and operations * Identifying problems proactively and solving them independently * Supporting onboarding workflows for new clients * Working with Shopify stores where required * Providing weekly campaign updates and operational updates Potential future client-facing opportunities are available for candidates with exceptional communication skills and presentation ability. --- ## What We’re Looking For ### Required Skills * Strong Google Ads experience * Strong Meta Ads experience * Good understanding of performance marketing * Understanding of marketing reporting and analytics * Comfortable using AI tools daily * Ability to think independently and solve problems * Strong written English communication * Organised and systems-oriented * High attention to detail ### Highly Valued * Experience with Shopify * Experience with GoHighLevel * Strong understanding of Google Tag Manager * Strong understanding of GA4 * Experience setting up and troubleshooting Meta Pixel and Events Manager * Experience with attribution and conversion tracking * Experience with automation tools like Zapier or Make * Experience using AI builders/tools such as Lovable * Basic SEO understanding * Design eye and understanding of good creative --- ## Growth Opportunity We are building this role for the long term. As the company grows, this position will continue to grow and evolve with it. For the right person, there is significant opportunity for: * increased responsibility * leadership opportunities * involvement in higher-level strategy * direct collaboration with the founder * long-term career growth inside the company This is a remote-first role, however for exceptional long-term tea ---------- mbers, there may also be opportunities over the next 12 to 24 months to become more directly involved with the Australian side of the business if desired. We are looking for somebody who wants to build something long-term, not somebody looking for a short-term freelance position. --- ## The Type of Person That Will Succeed Here You: * take initiative without being asked * enjoy solving problems * improve systems naturally * think critically * learn quickly * communicate clearly * care about results * want long-term growth * are comfortable in a fast-moving environment * use AI to work smarter and faster You probably will NOT enjoy this role if: * you need constant supervision * you wait for instructions for every task * you avoid ownership * you struggle with communication * you prefer repetitive admin-only work --- ## Hours * Full-time role * Flexible scheduling where needed * Must have overlap with Melbourne business hours --- ## To Apply Please answer the following carefully. We are not looking for perfect answers. We are looking for your thinking process, problem-solving ability, and how you approach challenges. ### Question 1 Tell us about a marketing or operational problem you noticed before anybody else did. How did you identify it? What did you do to solve it? What was the result? ### Question 2 Imagine a client’s Meta Ads performance suddenly drops by 40% this week. Walk us through: * what you would check first * how you would investigate the issue * what data you would look at * what actions you would take We care far more about your thinking process than having a “perfect” answer. ### Question 3 Tell us about a system or workflow you improved in a previous role. What was inefficient? What changes did you make? What impact did it have? ### Question 4 What AI tools do you currently use in your workflow, and how do they make you more effective? --- ## Final Notes We are building a high-performance, AI-first agency with strong systems and strong people. If you are ambitious, proactive, accountable, and want a long-term opportunity where you can grow into a major role inside the company, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Pinterest Organic Growth Specialist
description: Adventure Travel Brand - Long-Term Role Before you apply - please read carefully This role is 100% organic Pinterest. No Pinterest Ads. If your expertise is paid campaigns, this is not for you. You must specialise in Pinterest. General social media managers who cover five platforms will not be considered. Travel, gifting, or e-commerce experience is strongly preferred. This is a long-term role. We are building this channel over years, not weeks. We are looking for a minimum 2-year commitment from you. You must be available to work consistently 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday. About Us This Big World is an adventure travel brand. Our flagship product is a deck of Travel Challenge Cards sold on Amazon - a deck that turns any trip into an adventure by challenging travellers to find local oddities, eat unfamiliar food, explore off the tourist trail, and break out of standard sightseeing routines. We sell to two audiences: adventure travellers (the people who use the cards) and gift-givers (the people who buy them for travellers in their life). Our market is travellers and travel gift-buyers aged roughly 30+. We are not targeting Gen-Z TikTok travellers. Our audience is people with the means and inclination to travel adventurously, and the people who give them thoughtful gifts. The brand sits squarely in this older, more affluent travel space, and our Pinterest strategy reflects that. We are a small, founder-led business currently travelling nomadically through the Americas. We have a Substack publication, a thousands-strong photo and video library from our travels (Colombia, Costa Rica, Brazil, and more to come), and an Amazon listing with reviews and an established product. We also have an existing Pinterest account with approximately 12,000 followers, currently branded under a previous business name (Working Traveller). Before you start, we will rename the account to This Big World, update the linked website, and refresh the profile. The legacy pins and boards will be left in place - you will audit them, d ---------- which to redirect to new destinations, which to delete, and which to keep. You inherit algorithm trust and an existing follower base, not a blank slate. The Opportunity We are hiring a dedicated Pinterest Organic Growth Specialist to take complete ownership of our Pinterest channel and turn it into a predictable, long-term acquisition source. This is not a "post random pins" role. We are looking for someone who genuinely understands Pinterest SEO, visual psychology, click-through behaviour, and content repurposing - and who knows how to translate those into qualified traffic, email signups, and product sales. You will work directly with the founder, have significant autonomy over strategy and testing, and own the channel end-to-end. If you are currently limited to basic pin posting and account management but know you are capable of much more strategically, this could be a meaningful long-term role for you. Your Responsibilities 1. Daily content production - Publish approximately 10 fresh pins per day, scaling to 15+ pins per day as systems mature. - Work from our existing photo and video library (thousands of travel assets from Colombia, Costa Rica, Brazil and ongoing destinations), plus our Amazon product photography and any blog content from Substack. - Work directly with the brand owner to produce and create new unique content aligned with your keyword research and Pinterest SEO strategy — identifying gaps in our library, briefing what photos or videos to capture next, and suggesting content angles that match what people are actually searching for. - Create multiple pin variations from single source assets — different hooks, different titles, different visual treatments. - Produce all major pin formats: static pins, idea pins, carousel pins, and video pins. - Edit photos and short-form vertical video for Pinterest. 2. Account audit and rebuild - Audit our existing 12k-follower Pinterest account pin-by-pin. Identify which legacy pins still drive impressions, d ---------- which to redirect to new TBW destinations, which to delete, and which to keep. - Rebuild the board structure for the TBW brand (gift angles, destination itineraries, adventure travel themes, off-the-beaten-path stories). - Set up Rich Pins and any integrations between Pinterest and our Amazon listing. - Document a SEO strategy and publishing plan you will execute on an ongoing basis. 3. Pinterest SEO and keyword research - Perform deep keyword research within Pinterest for the adventure travel and gift markets. - Research trends and seasonal search opportunities (Christmas gift season starts in September on Pinterest). - Optimise pin titles, descriptions, hashtags, boards, and metadata. - Build keyword-rich descriptions designed to increase discovery, saves, outbound clicks, and ranking inside Pinterest search. - Treat Pinterest as a visual search engine, not a social media platform. 4. Strategy, testing, and optimisation - Develop scalable pin templates and systems. - Identify winning formats and double-down on them. A/B test hooks, titles, imagery, pin styles, and posting times. - Stay current with Pinterest algorithm changes and best practice. The platform shifts and we need you to shift with it. 5. Reporting and analytics - Provide weekly performance summaries covering pin output, top performers, and any tests in flight. - Provide monthly reports covering: impressions, saves, outbound clicks, top-performing pins, traffic to our destinations, email signups generated, and Amazon sales attributable to Pinterest. - Use Amazon Attribution links on every pin driving to our Amazon listing, so we can measure your impact on actual sales — not just Pinterest's internal click numbers. - We care about real metrics: Substack signups, Amazon sales, and discount code redemptions. Pinterest's own dashboard is directional, not a KPI. Required Experience - Hands-on Pinterest organic growth experience — accounts you have grown yourself, not accounts you have inherited or merely managed. - Demonstrable track record of growing Pinterest accounts from low to high monthly views and outbound clicks (screenshots will be required). - Strong Pinterest SEO knowledge — keyword research, fresh pin strategy, board structure, current algorithm understanding. - Ability to create high-converting pins — strong visual instincts, understanding of hooks, curiosity, and click psychology. - Canva design skills (or Photoshop equivalent). - Short-form vertical video editing skills (Capcut, Premiere, or equivalent). - Experience with Pinterest scheduling and research tools such as Tailwind and PinClicks (or equivalents). - Experience creating multiple Pinterest concepts from a single blog post or source asset. - Confident written English. You will be writing pin descriptions, board descriptions, and SEO copy. - Self-direction. We do not want to micromanage you. We want to brief you and trust you to run with it. - Reliable internet, your own equipment, ability to work 40 hours a week consistently. Bonus Experience (preferred, not required) - Pinterest traffic to Amazon listings specifically. - Shopify or Amazon as a traffic destination. - Travel content experience or genuine interest in travel. - Experience with Rich Pins and Pinterest-Shopify integrations. What We Don't Want xxx  Random pin posting without strategy xxx  Focus on impressions or saves as the goal (these are directional metrics, not outcomes) xxx  Generic Canva templates with no hook, no curiosity, no point of view xxx  Low-quality designs or recycled aesthetics that look like every other travel brand xxx. Anyone who cannot show real traffic and sales results from past work xxx  Agencies, outsourced teams, or middlemen xxx. General social media managers without specific Pinterest expertise xxx Anyone who treats this as a 6-month gig before moving to the next thing What We Offer - Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday. - Starting salary: USD $600-$800 per month, with room to grow to $1,000 for candidates who can demonstrate strong existing results. - 13th month bonus. - Compensation increases over time as you prove the strategy and results. - Genuine long-term role with significant upside as we scale. - Direct collaboration with the founder. - Clear ownership of the channel. You have autonomy and you are accountable for results. - Opportunity to shape the role over time - as the channel matures, you may move into a wider growth role. How To Apply This is a deliberately detailed application. We do this because we want serious applicants and we want to filter out copy-paste applications at the start. If the steps below feel like too much work, this role is not for you. Step 1: Send us our application Subject line: "Pinterest Specialist - [Your Name]" In the body of the email , please include: - Brief introduction about yourself. - Pinterest accounts you have personally managed (URLs). - Before/after analytics screenshots showing growth you drove. - 2-3 examples of specific pins you created that performed well, with the metrics (saves, outbound clicks, traffic driven). - Your Pinterest SEO methodology in 3-4 sentences - how you approach ranking in a visual search engine. - Tools you currently use (e.g. Tailwind, PinClicks, Canva, etc). - Your view on the state of Pinterest in 2026 - what is working right now and what is not. - Your time zone, working hours, and earliest start date. Step 2: Test task If selected for the next stage, you will be asked to complete a short test task. This is unpaid and gives us a clear view of how you think and what you produce. Details will be sent to shortlisted candidates. Step 3: Video interview If selected after the test task, you will be invited to a video interview. Step 4: Paid trial Successful candidates start with a one-month paid trial at the full agreed salary. At the end of month one, both parties d ---------- whether to continue. If we continue, this is a long-term role. Why This Role Is Different - This is a genuine opportunity to become the Pinterest growth lead for a growing brand. - We are not hiring someone to manage social media. We are hiring someone to own a channel, build it from an established but neglected foundation, and turn it into a measurable acquisition engine for years to come. - If that excites you, we want to hear from you. We respond to qualified applications within 48 hours.

As long as we stay within the original brief (same brand, same content, same purpose), all iterations are included in the project price. You don't need to charge me extra for revisions. If the brief changes a lot during the project (different brand, different content), I will treat it as a new project. Compensation $10 - $20 USD per finished E-Mail design We strongly want, that you work Long-Term. All iterations are included in this price. You don't need to charge me more for revisions, as long as we stay within the original brief. Payment after each completed and approved project, via your preferred method (PayPal, Wise, etc.). Long-Term Plan: Retainer If we work well together for 2-3 months, I want to move you to a monthly retainer: Fixed monthly payment for a guaranteed number of E-Mails Steady, predictable income for you Priority access to my projects Long-term partnership This is the goal. The project-based phase at the beginning is for us to get to know each other and see if we work well together. Working Hours / Volume Schedule: You set your own hours. No fixed schedule. Volume at start: Expect 5-15 E-Mail designs per month Volume potential: Could grow to 20-30 per month as my agency grows Response time: I expect a response within 24 hours when I send a project. Step 4: After 2-3 months of good collaboration, we move to a monthly retainer. I am NOT looking for someone with the lowest price. I am looking for someone with quality, reliability, and patience. If you give your best work, I will give you regular projects — and eventually a steady monthly income. Contact Toni Küster Founder, run.more.mails ---------- I look forward to working with you. — Toni

title: Klaviyo Email Marketing Specialist
description: About Us We are a fast-growing e-commerce company focused on funnel-driven dropshipping. Our goal is to maximize efficiency, conversion performance, and scalability by continuously optimizing our funnels, stores, and customer journeys. As part of our team, you will play a key role in building and optimizing our email marketing infrastructure, with opportunities to grow into senior CRM or retention leadership roles. Job Description We are looking for an experienced Klaviyo Email Marketing Specialist who will be responsible for managing, optimizing, and scaling our email marketing ecosystems within Klaviyo. In this role, you will ensure that all email flows, campaigns, segmentations, and automations operate flawlessly while driving maximum customer retention and revenue growth. You will work closely with the marketing, funnel, and design teams to create high-converting email campaigns and lifecycle flows. In addition, you will actively contribute ideas to improve customer journeys, AOV, retention, and LTV. Responsibilities Klaviyo Management & Optimization You will manage and optimize all Klaviyo accounts, flows, campaigns, and automations to ensure maximum performance and deliverability. Email Flows & Automations You will build, test, and optimize email flows such as: Welcome flows Abandoned cart flows Browse abandonment flows Post-purchase sequences Upsell & cross-sell flows Winback campaigns Campaign Management You will plan, create, and analyze email campaigns focused on revenue growth, customer retention, and engagement. Segmentation & Personalization You will develop advanced customer segments and personalized customer journeys based on customer data, behavior, and purchase history. Performance Monitoring & Testing You will monitor KPIs such as open rates, CTR, conversion rates, revenue per recipient, and deliverability. You will also conduct A/B testing to continuously improve performance. title: Client Success & Social Media Coordinator
description: ABOUT FORGE STUDIO Forge Studio is a Melbourne-based creative agency specialising in CGI, film, photography, and digital content for property developers and luxury brands. We deliver end-to-end visual campaigns — from 3D architectural renders and cinematic video through to social media management and brand strategy. Our clients include leading property groups across Melbourne and Bali, and we operate with a lean, high-output team supported by offshore production talent. We’re looking for a switched-on, detail-oriented coordinator to sit at the centre of our client delivery and social media operations — someone who can keep multiple workstreams moving, create compelling content, and maintain the quality standard our clients expect. ROLE OVERVIEW This is a hands-on execution role that bridges client success, social media management, and lightweight project coordination. You’ll be the connective tissue between our creative output and our clients’ audiences, scheduling content, managing approvals, building ad campaigns, and keeping render production workflows on track. You’ll work across multiple clients and platforms simultaneously, using Notion as your operating system, Dropbox as your asset library, and Meta Business Suite as your publishing and advertising engine. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Social Media Content Scheduling & Publishing • Source and curate creative assets from organised Dropbox folders — including photography, CGI renders, video stills, and branded collateral — selecting the right content for each client’s posting schedule and campaign objectives. • Write compelling, on-brand captions for every post, tailored to each client’s tone of voice, audience, and strategic goals. Captions must be engaging, grammatically polished, and optimised for platform-specific best practices (hashtags, CTAs, character limits, emoji usage). • Build and maintain content calendars on Notion, scheduling all creative assets, captions, posting dates, and platform assignments on dedicated client dashboards. Each post should be logged with its associated image, copy, target platform, and status (draft, pending approval, approved, published). • Submit all scheduled content for client approval via the Notion dashboard workflow before any content goes live. Track approval status, implement client feedback, and re-submit revised content as needed — ensuring nothing is published without sign-off. • Publish approved content via Meta Business Suite, scheduling posts across Facebook and Instagram at optimal times. Monitor publishing confirmations and troubleshoot any scheduling or delivery issues. • Maintain a consistent posting cadence across all active client accounts, ensuring no gaps in the content calendar and proactively flagging when new assets or approvals are needed to stay on schedule. 2. Meta Advertising (Paid Social) • Set up and launch ad campaigns in Meta Business Suite (Facebook Ads Manager / Instagram Ads) using pre-approved creative assets provided by the Forge Studio production team or sourced from Dropbox. • Configure campaigns end-to-end: select the correct campaign objective (awareness, traffic, engagement, conversions, leads), define target audiences using demographic, interest-based, and behavioural targeting, set budgets and bid strategies, and assign placements (Feed, Stories, Reels, Audience Network). • Build ad sets and individual ads with correct creative specifications — ensuring imagery and video meet Meta’s format, resolution, and aspect ratio requirements for each placement. • Write high-performing ad copy including primary text, headlines, and descriptions that align with the client’s brand voice and are optimised for click-through rate and conversion. • Implement tracking and attribution: install and verify Meta Pixel events, configure custom conversions where applicable, and ensure UTM parameters are appended to all destination URLs for accurate performance measurement. • Monitor campaign performance daily, reviewing key metrics (CPM, CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and making real-time optimisations — adjusting budgets, pausing underperforming ad sets, refreshing creative, and testing new audience segments. • Deliver regular performance reports to the Managing Director summarising spend, results, insights, and recommended next steps. Flag any issues with ad delivery, disapprovals, or account health promptly. • Stay current with Meta platform updates, algorithm changes, and advertising best practices to ensure all campaigns are built and optimised to the highest standard. 3. Project Workflow Management (3D Renders) • Set up and maintain project dashboards on Notion for active 3D render jobs, using the established Forge Studio workflow template. Each dashboard should track project phases, deliverable status, revision rounds, and key dates. • Receive client briefs, reference materials, and feedback and translate them into clear, actionable production notes for the offshore 3D rendering team. Notes must be specific, unambiguous, and include annotated references where necessary. • Relay revision notes and feedback between clients and the offshore team, ensuring nothing is lost in translation. Track all revision rounds on the Notion dashboard and confirm each round is actioned before moving to the next. • Manage project timelines and status updates, proactively chasing deliverables, flagging delays, and keeping the Managing Director informed of progress across all active render jobs. • Maintain organised file structures in Dropbox for each render project — including source files, reference imagery, client-approved finals, and version history. • Coordinate with the Managing Director on scope changes, additional revision requests, or any production issues that fall outside the original brief. 4. Client Communication & Account Management • Serve as a reliable day-to-day point of contact for assigned client accounts, responding to queries promptly and professionally. • Keep clients informed on content schedules, campaign progress, and render delivery timelines without being prompted — proactive communication is essential. • Manage client expectations around turnaround times, revision allowances, and deliverable scope, escalating to the Managing Director when decisions are needed. • Document all client interactions, briefs, and decisions on the relevant Notion dashboards to maintain a single source of truth across every workstream. TOOLS & PLATFORMS YOU’LL USE DAILY • Notion — Content calendars, project dashboards, approval workflows, task management • Dropbox — Creative asset storage, file sharing, and project folder structures • Meta Business Suite — Organic post scheduling, ad campaign setup, performance reporting • Facebook Ads Manager — Campaign creation, audience building, pixel management, optimisation • Figms — Light graphic design and asset resizing (bonus) • Slack or similar — Internal team communication REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE • Proven experience managing social media accounts for brands or agencies, including content scheduling, caption writing, and community awareness. • Demonstrated ability to set up, manage, and optimise Meta ad campaigns (Facebook and Instagram) with a clear understanding of campaign objectives, audience targeting, and performance metrics. • Strong written communication skills — you can write polished, engaging copy that adapts to different brand voices and audiences. • Highly organised with an ability to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously without dropping the ball. • Comfortable working in Notion as a central project management and scheduling tool. • Familiarity with Dropbox for file management and asset sourcing. • Detail-oriented — you catch typos, check links, verify image specs, and double-check approvals before anything goes live. • Self-directed and proactive — you don’t wait to be chased; you anticipate what’s needed and get ahead of it. • A basic understanding of visual aesthetics and brand consistency — you know when an image, layout, or caption feels off-brand. BONUS SKILLS (HIGHLY VALUED) • Basic video editing skills — ability to trim, resize, add captions or text overlays to short-form video content (Reels, Stories) using tools like CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar. • Graphic design capability — resizing assets, creating simple social tiles, adapting brand templates in Canva or Adobe Illustrator/Photoshop. • Experience with property, architecture, hospitality, or luxury brand marketing. • Familiarity with 3D render production pipelines or CGI workflows. • Basic understanding of SEO, Google Business Profile management, or email marketing platforms. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE • Content calendars are always populated at least two weeks ahead, with all posts drafted, captioned, and submitted for approval on time. • Meta ad campaigns are live, optimised, and consistently meeting or exceeding client KPIs. • 3D render dashboards are up to date, notes are relayed accurately, and the offshore team has everything they need to deliver without delays. • Clients feel looked after — they know where things are at without having to ask. • The Managing Director can trust that day-to-day operations are running smoothly and only needs to step in for strategic decisions.

description: SEO Specialist — GWIN HVAC & MRCOOL DIRECT What This Role Requires & What’s Expected The Strategy You’re Stepping Into: We’re building a pillar page + topic cluster SEO structure around the keyword “DIY mini split” to rank #1 on Google and get cited by AI tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews). You need to understand and execute this architecture — not learn it from scratch. What You Must Know How to Do 1. Pillar Page Management • Build and optimize a long-form authority page (2,000–10,000 words) targeting a broad head keyword • Structure it with proper H1/H2/H3 hierarchy, internal links to all cluster pages, E-E-A-T signals (author bios, credentials, reviews, trust badges) • Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, URL structure 2. Topic Cluster Execution • Write or manage 10–15 supporting cluster articles, each targeting a long-tail keyword • Every cluster article must bidirectionally link to the pillar — they need to understand why and enforce it • Know the difference between a pillar topic and a cluster topic 3. Schema Markup • FAQ schema, HowTo schema, Product schema • Know which schema types trigger Google features (People Also Ask, Featured Snippets, AI citations) • Work with a developer to implement correctly — not just generate JSON-LD and walk away 4. Keyword Research • Identify head keywords vs. long-tail keywords • Know search intent (informational, commercial, transactional) • Build a keyword map across the pillar and all cluster pages with no cannibalization • Know that we’re specifically targeting unbranded searches competitors aren’t owning 5. Backlink / Paid Article Campaign • Manage outreach to relevant websites for paid/editorial placements • Understand that these links must point primarily to the pillar page to pass authority • Vet domain quality (DA, relevance, real traffic — not link farms) • Track which links are live, where they point, and what anchor text is used 6. Technical SEO Basics • Page speed optimization (WebP images, lazy loading) • Mobile-first layout awareness • Canonical tags, redirect management (singular vs. plural URLs — we’ve dealt with this) • Google Search Console monitoring — impressions, clicks, ranking positions, crawl errors 7. On-Page Optimization • Know the right keyword density (not over-stuffing) • Bold strategic terms in content — but selectively (4–6 max per page) • Optimize image alt tags with 1–2 keywords per image • Write meta descriptions that convert clicks, not just include keywords 8. AI Search Visibility (Non-Negotiable in 2026) • Understand that Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity pull from well-structured, self-contained pages • Know how to write content that gets cited by AI engines (declarative sentences, FAQ structure, comprehensive single-page answers) • Schema markup is part of this — you need to connect these dots 9. Blog / Content Calendar Management • Plan and prioritize cluster articles based on keyword opportunity • Write directly • Know that every blog post needs a strategic internal linking plan before it’s published 10. Analytics & Reporting • Google Search Console — weekly check on rankings and impressions • Google Analytics — track organic traffic, time on page, bounce rate • Report on which cluster pages are ranking and which need work • Track backlink profile growth (Ahrefs or SEMrush) What’s Already in Place (You’re Inheriting) • Pillar page at /diy-mini-splits — partially built, actively being expanded • Several cluster blog articles need to live on the site • Paid article / backlink campaign underway targeting the pillar • Schema partially implemented on product pages • YouTube channel with growing content • Keyword master reference list built out Green Flags to Look For in Candidates • Has managed a pillar + cluster structure before (show us an example) • Understands E-E-A-T and can explain it without prompting • Knows the difference between schema types and when to use each • Has run a backlink outreach or paid placement campaign and can show results • Follows Google’s guidelines — not black-hat tactics that will get the site penalized Hours: Monday: 2pm central -5pm Central Tuesday-Frdaiy 8am Central-5pm Central Pay: Weekly pay on Wednesdays, pay period Monday-Sunday Pay method: WISE Must be okay with screen sharing during working hours

title: Podcast Research VA — List Building for Guest Pitching (No Outreach)
job_title: Podcast Research VA — List Building for Guest Pitching (No Outreach)
description: The Role I'm a 30+ year business owner who has been running a company with my husband, and I'm building a qualified list of podcast interview targets for myself as a solo guest. I need a research-only VA to find and qualify the right shows. This is a defined project, not an ongoing role. The total scope is approximately 200–300 qualified podcasts over 8–12 weeks. If the work goes well and a second research phase becomes useful after my first round of pitches, I'd want to continue with the same person — but I'm not promising ongoing work, and I want to be upfront about that so you can d ---------- if the scope fits you. This is research only. You will not write or send pitch email s, at least in this first round. Your job is to deliver clean, qualified podcast leads in a shared spreadsheet. I'll handle the outreach myself. What I Speak About so you can recognize a fit when you see it, my niche covers: - Couples in business together / husband-and-wife businesses - Spouse of an entrepreneur (the supporting partner perspective) - Long-term marriage paired with a long-term business (30+ year arc) - "Marriedpreneur" / "couplepreneur" life/ "husband-wife business"/ "founders life" - Adjacent: women in business who are married to entrepreneurs, faith-based women in business, family business / legacy I pitch as a solo guest, not as a couple. Deliverable Approximately 200–300 qualified podcasts total, delivered in weekly batches of 20–30 into a shared Google Sheet (I'll provide the template). Each row contains: - Podcast name - Host name(s) - Last episode date (confirmed from the feed) - Recent guest count (out of the last 10 episodes) - Audience signal (Apple ratings count, Listen Notes rank, or claimed downloads — whichever you can verify) - Topic relevance (1 sentence — how my niche fits) - Why this fits me (1 sentence) - Best contact method (email / website form / guest application page / social) - Media-first score (1–5 — see screening section below) - Source URL (Apple, Spotify, or host site) - Notes If you can't verify a data point, write "unverified" — do not guess. Inclusion Criteria A podcast qualifies only if ALL of these are true: 1. Topic relevance — host covers couples-in-business, spouse-of-entrepreneur, marriedpreneur life, OR is a women-in-business / faith-based business show whose audience would benefit from my angle. 2. Activity — new episode published within the last 60 days. 3. Format — interviews outside guests (not solo or co-hosts only). 4. Audience signal — at least one of: 100+ Apple Podcasts ratings, OR Listen Notes Global Rank under 10,000, OR 200+ downloads/episode per public claims. 5. Mid-tier preferred — Listen Notes rank roughly 2,000–50,000. Skip the very top of category charts; I already know those. CRITICAL: Screening for Media-First Hosts This is the most important part of the work. I want shows that are real media properties with engaged listeners — NOT shows that exist primarily as a marketing channel for the host's own paid course or coaching program. The latter rarely book outside guests with overlapping offers; the former are open and worth my time. Use this screening framework for every candidate, in this order: Where to look: 1. Podcast feed and recent episodes — is the show itself active and guest-driven? 2. Host website and bio — is the podcast presented as a standalone media property, or as a support channel for a paid offer? 3. Episode descriptions and guest patterns — do they regularly bring on outside guests rather than teaching solo? 4. Social profiles and pinned posts — does most promotion point to the show, or to their product? Specific checks: - Read the last 5–10 episode titles and note how many are guest interviews. - Search the host's site for the course/program name and compare it to the podcast theme. - Check whether the podcast has a separate landing page or just sits under the course brand. - Scan social posts for the ratio of episode promotion to product promotion. - Look for a free resources page, guest application, or media kit — this usually signals a broader media orientation. Scoring (1–5): - 5 — Pure media property. Almost all episodes are guest interviews. Podcast has its own landing page. Host clearly promotes the show as a show. - 4 — Mostly media. Strong guest cadence; host has a product but it doesn't dominate the show's identity. - 3 — Mixed. About half guests, half solo teaching. Worth pitching but expect more friction. - 2 — Mostly course-funnel. Show is largely solo episodes selling the host's program. Skip unless the host's niche directly maps to mine. - 1 — Pure funnel. Show exists only to promote the course. Do not include. Include 4s and 5s. Mark 3s for my review. Exclude 1s and 2s unless I specifically tell you otherwise. Sources to Draw From - Listen Notes (search by keyword, sort by rank) - Podchaser - Apple Podcasts and Spotify category charts (Entrepreneurship, Marriage, Christianity & Spirituality, Self-Improvement) - Guest histories of specific hosts I'll share with you (after the trial task) - Feedspot directories for marriage / couplepreneur / women-in-business categories Do not pad the list. Quality over quantity. If you can only find 18 qualified shows, deliver 18 — don't invent a 19th and 20th to hit the number. I will check. Trial Task (Paid) Before ongoing work, I run a paid trial: - Pay: $35 flat - Task: Research 10 podcasts using the criteria above, delivered as a filled-in spreadsheet - Turnaround: 48 hours from go-ahead - What I'm evaluating: Quality of fit (did you read my niche correctly?), depth of research (did you find shows I likely don't know about?), and accuracy on the media-first score. The strongest applicant is selected for the main project. Project Scope, Timeline & Pay This project has a deliberately staged structure because the size of this niche is genuinely uncertain — there may be 50 qualifying shows, there may be 200. We'll find out together. - Discovery batch: First 30 qualified podcasts, delivered in 1–2 weeks. This batch tells both of us how deep the niche runs before committing to a larger scope. - Continued research: Based on what the discovery batch reveals, I expect to commission additional batches of ~30 podcasts each, up to roughly 100 total, at the same rate. If the market is smaller than expected, we wrap earlier. - Pay: $4 per qualified podcast - Initial commitment: ~$120 for the discovery batch - Realistic total range: $120–$400 depending on what the research reveals - Quality clause: Pay applies to rows that pass spot-check. Rows with inaccurate data, padding, or that don't meet the criteria don't count toward the total. Be precise; don't pad. - Payment schedule: Paid per batch within 48 hours of acceptance - Communication: Brief weekly check-in (email /loom/zoom-15 min) during the project; async otherwise - Future extension: If a later round of pitches generates good responses and I commission research into adjacent niches, I'd offer that work to the same person first. Required Skills - Excellent written English - Spreadsheet fluency (Google Sheets) - Strong attention to detail — I will spot-check 3–5 rows in every batch. Inaccurate, padded, or AI-hallucinated entries will end the engagement. - Independent research capability - Reliable on deadlines Nice-to-Have - Prior podcast research or podcast guesting experience - Familiarity with Listen Notes, Podchaser, or Apple/Spotify podcast charts - Any background in marriage, family, faith-based business, or women-in-business spaces How to Apply Reply with: 1. Prior podcast research experience (if any) — even one example helps. 2. One podcast you'd recommend I pitch and a one-sentence reason why. This is the most important part of your reply — I read it first. Please do not suggest the obvious top-charting shows. 3. Your time zone and weekly availability. Generic AI-written replies that don't include a real podcast recommendation will be ignored. Looking forward to working with the right person.

Boosted posts and the small paid campaigns you run are improving on basic metrics. You know our audience better than I do on a day-to-day level because you are living in the feeds and the comments. title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
description: Hi, I am Charlotte, a fine art equine and canine photographer based in Georgia. I work with a high-end clientele who value aesthetics, experience, and quality above everything else. My brand reflects that, and so does the way I work. I am looking for a sharp, self-directed Digital Marketing VA who can take ownership of my online presence and run it with minimal input from me. If you need constant direction, this is not the right role. If you thrive on structure, take initiative, and have a genuine eye for luxury content, keep reading. --- ## Your Mission To manage and grow a consistent, high-quality digital marketing presence across multiple platforms that attracts the right clients, builds brand authority, and converts visibility into real enquiries. You will work from a clear system and a detailed strategy document, and you will be expected to think, not just execute. --- ## What You Will Own - Repurposing content I provide (blogs, email s, photos, video) into on-brand captions and posts using SpeakAI and Claude - Creating and scheduling content across Instagram, Facebook , Google Business Profile, LinkedIn, Pinterest, and Nextdoor - Managing and maintaining Flodesk email sequences, templates, and monthly newsletters - Monitoring social platforms for engagement, flagging messages and comments for my attention with a drafted response ready - Formatting and uploading blog posts - Designing Canva graphics using my brand templates and keeping the Canva workspace organised and current - Tracking and reporting analytics weekly and monthly via a Notion dashboard, with your own commentary and recommendations, not just numbers - Maintaining a clean, organised Notion workspace as the single source of truth for all tasks, content, and reporting - Growing our audience strategically, including follower growth activity on aspirational brand accounts within our target market --- ## You Will Thrive in This Role If You - Have a strong, independent work ethic and do not need to be told what to do next - Can read a brand and write in its voice, not yours - Understand the difference between content that looks good and content that converts - Have a genuine eye for luxury aesthetics and high-end visual content - Are fluent in AI tools, particularly Claude, and use them to work smarter, not just faster - Understand that posting is not a strategy, and that reach without conversion is just noise - Communicate efficiently: one consolidated message, not ten - Can manage multiple platforms and deadlines without creating complexity - Are proactive about learning, especially where AI tools are concerned - Have experience working with high-ticket or luxury brands --- ## The Non-Negotiables - Fluency in AI tools is not a nice-to-have. It is a core requirement. You will be expected to use Claude for copywriting and caption refinement, and to keep learning as the tools evolve - Strong written English is essential. You will be representing a premium brand in every caption, email , and comment - You must be able to work independently to a weekly schedule without daily check-ins - Nothing goes live without approval. You will manage the pipeline and flag content for review, not post autonomously - This role requires a genuine understanding of luxury brand positioning. Generic, motivational, or AI-obvious copy is not acceptable --- ## Tools You Will Use - SpeakAI (primary content creation and image matching tool) - Claude (copywriting, caption refinement, brand voice) - Canva (design and visual content) - Metricool (scheduling) - Flodesk (email marketing) - Notion (task management, content planning, reporting) - Google Business Profile - Meta Business Suite - CapCut or similar (video editing for reels) - Loom (SOPs and process documentation) - Fathom (Zoom recording review) - PixieSet (client image gallery, approved folders only) - Google Drive --- ## A Note on Brand Charlotte Detienne Photography serves horse owners and dog owners who invest in fine art wall pieces, not digital files. The clientele is affluent, aesthetically minded, and values experience over transaction. The content needs to reflect that world: specific, observational, understated, and never generic. If you read that and thought, "I can do generic but make it sound fancy," this is not the right role. If you read that and immediately understood the difference, we should talk. --- To apply, please send your resume and portfolio showing relevant work with two or three examples of content you have created for a premium or luxury brand, and a brief note on how you use AI tools in your current workflow. Include the word "equine" somewhere in your application.

title: SEO & GEO Specialist
description: OUR COMPANY BACKGROUND Authority Solutions® is a digital marketing agency that focuses on Web Design, SEO (Search Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and AI-powered marketing technology to increase revenue for our clients. Founded in 2014, the company has grown year over year and has worked with remote tea ---------- mbers in the Philippines since the beginning. We serve clients in Medical, Legal, Ecommerce, and Home Services verticals. The company plans to 3X its revenue in the next 12 months, and this role is central to making that happen. We are not a typical agency. We use AI — Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity — as core production tools, not novelties. We build structured frameworks and systems for SEO and GEO execution. We make decisions from data, not guesses. If you want to do real technical SEO work inside a team that's operating at the front edge of where search is going — keep reading. JOB OVERVIEW We're hiring a technical SEO specialist who can execute across three domains: 1) Technical SEO & Site Architecture (40%) — Conduct full technical audits, diagnose crawlability and indexation issues, resolve Core Web Vitals problems, optimize site architecture, and implement fixes across WordPress sites. You find what's broken, you explain why it matters, and you fix it or direct the fix with precision. 2) On-Page Optimization & Structured Data (30%) — Implement on-page SEO at the element level: title tags, meta descriptions, header hierarchy, internal linking architecture, image optimization, and schema markup. You own structured data — JSON-LD, entity relationships, knowledge graph signals. You don't just know what schema is; you can hand-write it, validate it, and deploy it. 3) SEO Reporting, Strategy & Client Deliverables (30%) — Build and maintain client-facing SEO reports. Track keyword rankings, organic traffic, Core Web Vitals, and conversion metrics. Prepare strategy documents and audit deliverables that leadership presents to clients. Your analysis is clear enough that someone else can walk a client through it without needing to ask you what you meant. This is not a content writing role. We have separate systems and tea ---------- mbers for article production. You will not be writing blog posts. If content production is your primary skill, this is not the right fit. This is not a client-facing role. Leadership handles all client communication. You will never be on a client call. Your work speaks through the deliverables you produce and the results you drive. WHO YOU ARE You're a technician. You find more satisfaction in a clean crawl report with zero errors than in a well-written paragraph. You think in systems. Site architecture, internal linking logic, crawl budgets, and entity relationships make sense to you without explanation. You can open a website you've never seen before and, within 15 minutes, identify the three most impactful technical issues holding it back — and explain exactly what to do about each one. You use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity) daily as part of your workflow — for research, analysis, schema generation, audit documentation — not because someone told you to, but because you've figured out they make you faster and better. You've touched enough WordPress sites to be dangerous. You can navigate the admin, identify plugin conflicts, edit theme files when needed, and implement technical changes without breaking things. When someone says "schema markup," you don't Google it. You open a text editor and start writing JSON-LD. You document what you do. Your audits, reports, and deliverables are structured, clear, and usable by others without a walkthrough. REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS Technical SEO - Site Auditing — Full technical audits: crawlability, indexation, redirect chains, canonical issues, duplicate content, orphan pages, XML sitemaps, robots.txt - Core Web Vitals — LCP, INP, CLS diagnosis and resolution. You understand what causes poor scores and how to fix them, not just how to read the report. - Site Architecture — URL structure, internal linking strategy, crawl budget optimization, siloing, breadcrumb implementation - Mobile & Page Speed — Responsive design validation, image optimization, lazy loading, render-blocking resource diagnosis - Crawl Analysis — Log file analysis, crawl visualization, identifying crawl traps and wasted crawl budget On-Page SEO & Structured Data - On-Page Elements — Title tags, meta descriptions, header hierarchy (H1–H6 logic), keyword placement, image alt text, internal link anchor text optimization - Schema Markup / JSON-LD — Hand-writing and deploying structured data: LocalBusiness, Organization, Service, FAQPage, HowTo, Article, BreadcrumbList, Person, Product. You ---------- architecture, entity nesting, and knowledge graph signals. This is not optional — it's central to the role. - Entity SEO — Understanding how search engines build entity relationships and how to optimize for entity-based indexing Reporting & Analysis - Google Search Console — Performance analysis, index coverage, Core Web Vitals reporting, manual action monitoring, URL inspection - Google Analytics (GA4) — Traffic analysis, conversion tracking, audience segmentation, event-based measurement - Rank Tracking — Keyword position monitoring, SERP feature tracking, competitive visibility analysis - Client Deliverables — Building structured audit reports, monthly performance reports, and strategy documents that are clear, professional, and data-backed Core Tools (Day-One Proficiency Required) - Ahrefs — Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, Content Gap, Backlink analysis, Site Audit - Google Search Console — Full operational proficiency - Screaming Frog — Technical crawls, custom extraction, crawl analysis - WordPress — Admin navigation, plugin management, on-page implementation, basic theme file editing, Yoast/RankMath configuration AI-Assisted SEO (Hard Requirement) - Claude, ChatGPT, and/or Perplexity — Daily proficiency. You use AI tools to accelerate research, generate and validate schema, analyze competitors, draft audit findings, and improve your output quality. This is not a "nice to have." If you are not already using AI tools in your SEO workflow, you are behind where we need you to be. - You can evaluate AI-generated outputs critically — you know when the AI is right, when it's hallucinating, and when it's giving you a generic answer that doesn't apply to the specific situation. PREFERRED / NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) GEO is an emerging discipline, and we don't expect deep expertise on day one. But we're building frameworks for it internally, and the right candidate will have genuine curiosity and foundational understanding in this area. If you have exposure to any of the following, call it out in your application: - Understanding of how LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) select, rank, and cite sources in their responses - Experience analyzing AI-generated search results (Google AI Overviews, Perplexity citations, ChatGPT search) - Knowledge of how structured data, entity markup, and citation architecture influence AI visibility - Awareness of how GEO differs from traditional SEO — what signals matter, what doesn't transfer, and where the discipline is still unproven A note on honesty: GEO is new. Very few people have real operational experience with it. If you've read about it and find it interesting, say that. If you've run actual GEO campaigns with measurable results, we absolutely want to hear about it. What we don't want is a resume that claims "GEO Expert" based on watching a webinar. We will test for this in the interview, and the difference between genuine understanding and surface-level awareness is obvious within about 90 seconds. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Technical SEO Auditing & Implementation - Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits for client websites across multiple verticals (Medical, Legal, Ecommerce, Home Services) - Identify, prioritize, and resolve technical issues: crawl errors, indexation problems, redirect chains, canonical conflicts, site speed, Core Web Vitals - Implement fixes directly in WordPress or document implementation specs for developer handoff - Monitor and maintain technical health across the client portfolio on an ongoing basis Schema & Structured Data - Write, validate, and deploy JSON-LD schema across client sites - Build and maintain schema at the site level (Organization, LocalBusiness, Service) and page level (FAQPage, HowTo, Article, BreadcrumbList, Person, Product) - Ensure structured data supports both traditional SERP features (rich results) and emerging AI citation signals - Maintain schema documentation and templates for repeatable deployment across verticals On-Page SEO Execution - Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, header structures, internal linking, image alt text, and anchor text across client sites - Conduct on-page audits and implement changes aligned with keyword targeting and site architecture strategy - Build and maintain internal linking architectures that support both crawl efficiency and topical authority Reporting & Client Deliverables - Build monthly client performance reports covering rankings, traffic, Core Web Vitals, and key metrics - Prepare technical audit reports with prioritized findings and clear implementation recommendations - Create strategy documents that leadership can present to clients without additional context - Track and report on keyword rankings, SERP feature visibility, and competitive positioning Research & Competitive Analysis - Conduct keyword research and competitive gap analysis using Ahrefs and SEMrush - Analyze competitor sites for technical SEO advantages, content gaps, and backlink profiles - Monitor SERP landscape changes, algorithm updates, and industry developments - Research and report on AI/GEO developments as the discipline evolves AI-Integrated Workflow - Use Claude, ChatGPT, and Perplexity as daily production tools for research, analysis, schema generation, and audit documentation - Evaluate and integrate new AI tools and workflows as they become relevant to SEO execution - Contribute to internal AI-powered SEO frameworks and processes as they're developed WORK SCHEDULE & HOLIDAYS All staff work a split shift so we can communicate on pertinent tasks or have tea ---------- etings as needed with US leadership. As a company we observe all US holidays, as well as PH public holidays (New Year's Day, Lunar New Year, Maundy Thursday, Good Friday, Bataan Day, Labour Day, Philippines Independence Day, National Heroes' Day, Bonifacio Day, Feast of the Immaculate Conception, Christmas Day, Rizal Day). We work hard and value time with our families. After 90 day probationary period all staff qualify for leave with proper notice based on employee handbook regulations. PERKS & BENEFITS - Access to paid SEO tools and platforms (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, and additional tools as needed) - Access to AI tools (Claude Pro, ChatGPT, Perplexity Pro) - Access to paid training and courses for professional development - Direct access to company leadership — your ideas get heard and implemented fast - Opportunity to be part of building GEO frameworks from the ground up as the discipline matures — you won't just be following playbooks, you'll be helping write them - Small team environment where your contributions are visible and valued - Clear path to increased responsibility and compensation as the company scales HOW TO APPLY Do not send a generic application. We will ignore it. We've hired extensively in the Philippines for over a decade. We know what a real SEO operator looks like, and we know what a padded resume looks like. The application instructions below are designed to separate the two. Include the following in your application: 1. A brief introduction Who you are, how many years you've been doing SEO, what kinds of clients or sites you've worked on, and why this role interests you. Keep it under 200 words. 2. Your live audit — this is required Pick any live website (not one you've worked on — pick a random local business, a competitor in any niche, anything). Using any tool you have access to, identify three specific technical SEO issues on that site. For each issue: - Screenshot your finding from the tool - Explain what the issue is in plain language - Explain what you would do to fix it and why it matters This should take a competent SEO specialist 10-15 minutes. If it would take you significantly longer, this role is probably not the right fit. Applications without this audit will not be reviewed. 3. One question you have about the role This tells us you actually read the posting.

title: Social Media and E-Commerce Marketing Specialist

Accountability & Operations - Daily Communication: Send a brief, structured daily email summary outlining the tasks completed and immediate focus areas. We want to maintain a highly collaborative, transparent relationship so you always feel supported and motivated! - AI Leverage: Actively utilize modern AI tools (like ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.) to optimize workflows, refine copy, and streamline your daily tasks. JOB REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS 1. Experience: 2+ years of experience managing social media accounts and digital marketing tasks for e-commerce brands. 2. Flawless English: Because you will be communicating directly with our customers and posting publicly on our official brand accounts, your written English must be perfect—free of typos and grammatical errors. 3. Mission Make marketing ship. The Head of GTM sets the strategy and owns the budget. The channel specialists own the craft. You are the operational backbone — you turn strategy into project plans, run the delivery cadence, and unblock specialists so their work lands on time and on scope. Specialists hit their numbers because you're behind the scenes making it happen. What you'll own - Project planning. Translate the Head of GTM's priorities into clear plans — milestones, dependencies, owners, deadlines. One plan per major initiative (Google Ads scale, SEO foundation, Reddit launch, etc.). The Head of GTM guides and supports you through this — you're not planning alone. - Task tracking. Every project broken into trackable tasks in our PM tool (Asana/Notion). Status is always current. Nothing lives only in your head. - Specialist support. Daily or weekly check-ins with each specialist (depending on the project phase). What do you need? What's blocking you? What's the next deliverable? You unblock first, escalate only when you can't resolve it. - Cross-specialist coordination. When the SEO specialist needs a tracking event from the Tracking specialist, you connect them. You see the full board; each specialist sees only their lane. - Cadence. You run a weekly review with all specialists + Head of GTM. Sharp, fast: status, blockers, decisions needed. No theatre. - Documentation. Decisions, deliverables, dependencies, what worked, what didn't. You build the operating system, not a memory. KPIs you'll be measured on - % of projects delivered on time. Did we ship what we said, when we said? - Time-to-unblock. When a specialist flags a blocker, how fast does it resolve? Most should clear within 48 hours. - Specialist clarity. Do specialists always know what they're working on, what's next, and what they're waiting on? Measured by a quick weekly pulse (1–5). - Head of GTM visibility. Zero surprises. The Head of GTM should never have to ask 'what's happening with [project]?' — the answer is already in the dashboard. Profile — must-haves - 3+ years in project / program / delivery management — ideally in marketing, growth, or creative ops. Other domains OK if the operating cadence was similar (multiple parallel workstreams, external specialists, weekly delivery). - Fluent in at least one PM tool (Asana, Notion, etc.). You've built project boards from scratch, not just used templates. - Comfortable being the most organized person in the room that has marketing experience, NOT the most expert. You ask great questions; you don't pretend to have answers you don't have. - Strong written communication — most of this job is written briefs, status updates, and decision logs. - Calm under deadline pressure. Specialists will miss things; you don't panic, you re-plan. - Comfortable working async with a small remote team across time zones. Profile — nice-to-haves - Past work coordinating paid acquisition, SEO, content, or community-led marketing — as the coordinator, not the expert. - Experience working with freelancers / external contractors (most of our specialists are project-based). - Familiarity with attribution / lead funnels conceptually. You don't need to set them up — just enough context to plan the work around them. How we work - Remote, async-first. Most of the team is in EU/Africa time zones; we sync 1–2x/week. - The Head of GTM is your direct line. They set priorities and own strategy; you translate those into plans and run delivery. - Specialists work with you on delivery. Their craft autonomy is theirs; your job is to make sure they have what they need to deliver. - Outcomes over hours. We don't care when you work; we care that things ship. - Small team, no bureaucracy. If a process doesn't help us ship, kill it. Qualification question (please answer in your application) Walk us through the most complex multi-stakeholder project you've delivered. How many specialists/owners were involved, what was the timeline, what blocked it, and how did you keep it on track? Be specific — names of tools, cadence of check-ins, what you did when something slipped.

title: Amazon PPC Manager
description: # Amazon PPC Manager (Only Zest) — JD **Location:** Remote, Philippines-based **Type:** Full-time **Salary:** $800 - $1,000 USD/month based on experience, BEFORE performance bonus **Hours:** Mon-Fri 12pm-10pm SGT (GMT+8), 30 min lunch break. 44 hrs/week, 176 hrs/month. --- Only Zest is a Singapore-based Amazon FBA brand selling paper-based consumer products. We're doing approximately 7-figures annualised on Amazon US, with 30+ active ASINs and ~$39K/month in ad spend. We are scaling the Amazon side and need an Amazon PPC Manager to own, optimise, and scale our advertising across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display. You will work alongside our existing PPC operations and our AI Performance Director (Rex) who runs weekly portfolio analysis. ## Role overview You will drive profitable growth using tools like Helium 10, Scale Insights, and DataDive, while building SOPs that make results repeatable. The single most important metric we're tracking: getting our TACoS down from 32% to 20% within 18 months by getting paid spend to compound into organic rank. This is for a results-oriented operator who works with minimal supervision and wants to grow alongside a high-performing team. ## Key responsibilities - Manage, optimise, and scale Amazon PPC campaigns across 30+ active ASINs to hit ACoS and TACoS targets - Analyse performance metrics (CTR, CVR, ACoS, TACoS, ROAS) and present clear actionable insights - Develop and execute keyword and targeting strategies (branded, competitor, category, PAT, defence) - Use automation tools to streamline campaign optimisation and scaling - Build and maintain SOPs for consistency, efficiency, and future team scaling - Drive high-quality traffic efficiently to product listings to maximise ROI - Familiarise yourself with SEO, listing optimisation, and keyword targeting so you know what to aim for - Work alongside an AI Performance Director (Rex) that already runs weekly diagnostics, so you can focus on execution and judgement, not dashboard building ## What we are looking for - **3 to 4 years** of hands-on Amazon PPC management with proven success in scaling campaigns - Strong analytical mindset and deep understanding of Amazon advertising metrics - Skilled in Excel or Google Sheets for performance tracking - Familiarity with tools like Scale Insights, Helium 10, and DataDive - Strategic thinker who can balance growth goals with daily optimisations - Goal-oriented, proactive, comfortable working with minimal supervision - **Fluent with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) as part of your daily workflow.** We use AI internally as a force multiplier and we want to see how you leverage it. Equally important: you can spot when AI is wrong and push back. We do not want AI sycophants. ## What you will bring - A results-driven approach focused on profitable growth - Clear communication and the ability to present insights simply - Proactive problem-solving: you anticipate and fix issues early - Passion for staying ahead of Amazon's evolving ad platform - Team-oriented mindset, you want to build the company together ## Application instructions, read carefully To be considered you must include all four of the following or your application will be skipped: 1. Put the word **AMAZON** at the very top of your reply 2. Your CV or resume 3. A short video introduction explaining why you are a great fit for this role 4. Your current status: why you are leaving your last job, or what you were doing just before applying Applications with video introductions will be prioritised. Applications missing any of the above will not be entertained. We screen the application's screening questions HARD. Generic, AI-sounding, or vague answers are auto-rejected. We're only interested in candidates who can think and write specifically. ## Important note This is not an entry-level position. If you are new to the workforce or lack relevant Amazon PPC experience, please do not apply. ## Stage 2 (for shortlisted candidates only) — AI Co-Pilot Test A **single 60-minute live working session** over Zoom or Google Meet. We pay **US$10** on completion regardless of outcome. How it works: - We hand you a real anonymised OZ portfolio snapshot (30 ASINs, ad spend, ACoS, TACoS, inventory, CVR) - Your job: identify the 3 biggest opportunities for next week - **AI use is mandatory.** Use Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, your choice. You must share your screen the entire time so we can see how you direct AI. - At the end, you present your 3 opportunities. We ask follow-up questions, including: "Which AI suggestion did you reject and why?" We're not testing whether you know PPC, we're testing how you think with AI as your co-pilot, what you catch that AI misses, and how you push back when AI is wrong. There is no preparation needed. --- Best regards, Jerald Only Zest
